But there is also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" used for forging "流动人口婚育证明". So maybe they use same label for any forgery of documents used for financial fraud. However there is also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" for forging "流动人口婚育证明". So we can use that.

Let's check that example: The Liu2 case: they used forged land use certificates to get loans. The label given: "贷款诈骗". So they didn't include forgery label. So likely the main charge is "贷款诈骗".
